text:
Miriam L (Finance): Heads-up — multiple EU resellers flagged a currency rounding discrepancy on the April Azure Marketplace settlements. Partner examples attached, they say per-invoice rounding pushed totals ~€6,430 higher than expected across three partners.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Curious — is this from USD->EUR conversion rounding or an Azure reported gross vs. net handling mismatch? Need sample lines and partner invoice ids.

Carlos P (Revenue Ops): Got a CSV from PartnerCloud, here's a snippet they sent: 
```
invoice_id,line_id,sku,usage,unit_price_usd,charge_usd,charge_eur_reported
AZ-5001,L-501,sku-pro,10000,0.015,150.00,134.23
AZ-5001,L-502,sku-pro-tax,10000,0.015,150.00,134.23
```
They claim the two lines were identical but converted separately and both rounded up, causing a ~€0.46 extra per duplicate line -> aggregated.

Anika S (Sales): We rolled a backlog mapping for VAT-flagged SKUs on Apr 2 which duplicated a tax-tagged line for certain channel partners. That could explain duplicate lines + separate FX conversions. PartnerCloud opened a ticket.

BillingBot: Azure payout status for PartnerCloud (partner_id PC-221): scheduled payout 2026-04-25T07:00:00Z, pending. No holds.

Miriam L (Finance): Proposal: run a targeted adjustment to correct duplicates and apply currency-precise credit in EUR to partner ledger. Because FX rates vary, recommend we calculate the credit in the partner's reported EUR amounts to match their expectation.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Agreed. Operational steps: 1) verify duplicated lines across partner settlements, 2) compute EUR credit per partner using settlement conversion table, 3) require partner acceptance of the correction and waiver for the corrected period, 4) apply manual credit and reduce payout.

Sofia (Legal): I'll prepare short amendment language: "Partner consents to a one-time correction limited to the April 2026 settlement period correcting duplicated VAT-tagged invoice lines. Correction amount will be paid in the currency reported on the affected settlement and constitutes full settlement for the corrected lines." Will circulate.

Carlos P (Revenue Ops): I'm running a quick query to count affected partners and total delta. Expecting 3 partners and EUR 6,430 total based on PartnerCloud's initial report.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Once we have partner-signed amendments, I'll post manual credits with memo AZ-MP-2026-04-FX-ADJ and tag GL 4205-REV-CR. BillingBot, please hold payouts for the three partners once finance marks them as pending adjustment.

BillingBot: Acknowledged. Will place temporary holds when Finance flags partner IDs.

Carlos P (Revenue Ops): Confirmed affected partners: PartnerCloud (PC-221), EuroResell (ER-54), and NordTrade (NT-9). Aggregated EUR delta 6,430. Running per-partner breakdown now.

Anika S (Sales): Reached out to all three partners with the draft language and proposed credit amounts. Asked for signed acceptance by EOD.

Sofia (Legal): Sent amendment via DocuSign at 2026-04-23T10:15:00Z. Clause includes waiver and currency-notice.

Anika S (Sales): PartnerCloud signed at 2026-04-23T13:02:00Z; EuroResell signed at 2026-04-23T15:08:00Z. NordTrade requested one small clarifying edit about tax reporting — I updated and re-sent.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Applying credits for PartnerCloud and EuroResell now. Memo AZ-MP-2026-04-FX-ADJ. PartnerCloud credit EUR 2,540; EuroResell credit EUR 1,900. Queuing NordTrade after signed doc.

Miriam L (Finance): GL entries noted: Debit Revenue 4205-REV-CR / Credit AP-Partner 2202. We're using partner-reported EUR amounts to avoid FX mismatch. Please log exchange-rate reference in the memo.

BillingBot: Payout holds applied to affected partner records. NordTrade remains pending until signed amendment.

NordTrade (via Sales update): NordTrade signed at 2026-04-23T17:40:00Z after minor edit; accepted EUR 1,990 credit and waiver.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Posted NordTrade credit, total EUR 6,430 applied. Reduced payouts accordingly and updated ledger. Memo AZ-MP-2026-04-FX-ADJ.

Miriam L (Finance): Confirmed postings. Closing note: schedule a short cross-functional check to ensure VAT-tagged SKU mapping rollouts include a dedupe step before settlement propagation. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Carlos P (Revenue Ops): Adding to weekly ops review and will propose a lightweight automated diff check between pre- and post-mapping settlements.

BillingBot: All affected payouts updated. No further action pending.
